_note: Story 068 (owner playtest 5: feeling stuck). When the client asks something, a small 'waiting for' line shows her question (up to questionMaxChars). A miss is her asking to hear it again (sayAgain patterns, case-insensitive) or the player's reply graded 'Try this'. After missesForHelp misses on the same question the companion opens with her tip (or a hint with a ready line). After missesBeforeDefault misses the client picks a sensible answer herself and moves on (the next turn tells the AI so), with a gentle stuckMood dip. Story 068b: when the companion helps on a miss, her top card answers the client's OPEN QUESTION directly. A choice question ('short or medium?') gives one line per choice from answers.choice ({X} = the choice, {x} lower case); a yes/no question (starts with a yesNoStart word) gives answers.yesNo; anything else gives answers.open. words gives the Vietnamese for common choices (shown under the English line in Vietnamese). The Vietnamese lines never hardcode chị/em/anh (the client's title varies).
